headlines.text: Looking back to 2025, when history was made as Mercedes Mone vs. Zeuxis contested the very first CMLL Women's World Title match, appearing on Grand Slam: Mexico, rated 6.34. Mon? added another notch to her growing championship collection, defeating Zeuxis to win the CMLL World Women's Championship at Grand Slam Mexico inside Arena Mexico.
Flash back to 2021, when Ethan Page & Scorpio Sky left that name behind for good, stepping out as Men of the Year after 2 matches under the old identity, on Dynamite.

On this day in 2025, Atlantis kicked off their AEW journey against Alexander, Fletcher & Takeshita vs. Fletcher & Takeshita vs. Adam Cole Jr. vs. Bandido vs. Brody King vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Templario vs. Dax Harwood vs. Hechicero vs. Josh Alexander vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Kyle Fletcher vs. Lance Archer vs. Volador Jr., appearing on Grand Slam: Mexico, rated 6.77.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, Young Bucks & Moxley vs. The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. Moxley & Yuta vs. The Young Bucks vs. The Beast Mortos vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. Jon Moxley vs. Matthew Jackson vs. Nicholas Jackson vs. Katsuyori Shibata vs. Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Samoa Joe vs. Swerve Strickland vs. Will Ospreay headlined Grand Slam: Mexico, rated 7.73 ? a match that delivered, on an outstanding Grand Slam: Mexico '25 show that earned an overall rating of 8.47.
2021 brought us this moment: Brock Anderson touched down in AEW for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.41.
That Wednesday in 2025, it marked the first-ever meeting between Mistico and MJF on Grand Slam: Mexico, rated 7.42 ? a good, competitive contest.
